scope: Four deliberately edited sources, each with unrestricted Init/Next, TypeInvariant and SetInvariant, deadlock enabled; counts of actual labeled states and generated witnesses. Published F1 retains all three properties. Full runs do not establish F1.

source.full_cfg:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANTS TypeInvariant SetInvariant

host.full: EC2 c7i.4xlarge, us-east-2b, Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C. Each variant ran pinned to logical CPU 0. Trials within each family were sequential. Use timings as single observations, without attributing differences solely to the number of states.
host.cross_controls: Second c7i.4xlarge in us-east-2b. Native Core and pinned TLC sequential on logical CPUs 0-3. Alternate full search on CPU 5. Interface-only controls on CPUs 12 and 14. Final module-closure and operand-totality controls on CPUs 0, 2, 3, 4 concurrently. GNU time process wall and peak RSS in KiB.

commands.full: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=$WORKER $WORKER/python/bin/python3 scripts/perf/scale/emergencycall.py MODULE full.cfg --variant VARIANT --exporter $WORKER/symbolic_input
commands.core: dive check MODULE --config f1.cfg --store exact --workers 4 --compat=tlc --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 10g --time-limit 1500s --output json
commands.tlc: java -Xmx6g -XX:+UseParallelGC -cp tla2tools.jar tlc2.TLC -workers 4 -seed 0 -fp 0 -metadir TMP -config f1.cfg MODULE
commands.trace: Append --trace PATH --validator DIVE to the benchmark command for the published s0 or full plus F1 configurations. Exit 1 is the validated counterexample.

independent_initial_cardinality: N is the set of non-emergency numbers and E the union of emergency candidates. Full Init count = 2^17 * (|E|+1) * sum |{a,b,c,d}| over (a,b,c,d) in N x E x (N union E) x E. The sum counts the choice from the four stored number fields, with duplicates removed. Fixed initial choices recover their witnesses for these pinned edits.
alternate_method: Same bound TLA+ and earlier expression evaluation; independent strict BFS with reversed action order, simultaneous substitution and 64 fixed-policy cofactors. Counts and depth are compared exactly; this shares front-end semantics.
